# Orion

> Orion is a declarative services runtime for REST APIs, webhooks, background jobs, event consumers, GraphQL APIs, and Server-Sent Events. You define workflows, channels, and connections as JSON files, validate and test them offline with `orion-cli`, compile them into immutable deployments, and apply or roll back revisions atomically through the `/api/v2/admin/` API. Written in Rust; runs as a single binary (`orion-server` for Community, `orion-ext` for Standard & Enterprise) with embedded SQLite by default and PostgreSQL or MySQL in production.

Key facts: workflows execute tasks sequentially over a shared JSON message (`data`, `metadata`, `temp_data`) using JSONLogic expressions; channels expose workflows over REST, HTTP, cron, Kafka, GraphQL, or SSE and enforce authentication, rate limiting, deduplication, caching, and backpressure before any task runs; connectors bind external databases, APIs, caches, and enterprise providers (`com.orion.*`) using `env://` and `vault://` secret locators; WebAssembly plugins extend task functions in a sandboxed Wasmtime runtime; upgrading from 1.x to 2.0 starts on a fresh state database (`releases/upgrade-to-2.0.html`). The full documentation concatenated into one file is at https://docs.goplasmatic.io/llms-full.txt

## Get started

- [Orion documentation](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/introduction.html): overview of Orion, how workflows, channels, and connectors fit together, and where to start
- [Quickstart](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/get-started/quickstart.html): start Orion, compile and deploy the order-processing example, send a request, and inspect the execution trace in 5 minutes
- [Install and run Orion](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/get-started/install.html): install `orion-server` and `orion-cli` via Homebrew, shell script, Docker, or source, start the server, and verify `/healthz` and `/readyz`
- [Build your first service](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/get-started/first-service.html): write `workflow.json` and `channel.json` from scratch, run `lint` and `dry-run` offline, compile, deploy, and call your endpoint
- [Build a Postgres-backed orders API](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/get-started/postgres-orders-api.html): end-to-end tutorial building a validated REST API backed by PostgreSQL (`data_write` and `data_query`), tested offline with stubs and regression cases
- [Run the example packages](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/get-started/examples.html): tour and walkthrough of the deployable example packages (`order-processing`, `webhook-transform`, `api-composition`, `rate-limited-endpoint`)
- [When to use Orion](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/get-started/when-to-use-orion.html): how Orion compares with durable execution engines, API gateways, workflow automation tools, rule engines, and embedding `dataflow-rs`

## Core concepts

- [Architecture and request lifecycle](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/concepts/architecture.html): the three core primitives, a request's end-to-end journey through guards and tasks, sync vs. async execution, runtime capability map, and engineering design notes
- [Workflows and data context](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/concepts/workflows.html): task pipelines, the shared message envelope (`payload`, `data`, `metadata`, `temp_data`), JSONLogic conditions vs. templates, and workflow selection
- [Channels and ingress](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/concepts/channels.html): ingress protocols (`rest`, `http`, `cron`, `kafka`, `graphql`, `sse`), sync vs. async execution modes, guard evaluation order, and `channel_call` composition
- [Connectors and secrets](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/concepts/connectors.html): named connections (`http`, `db`, `cache`, and `com.orion.*` providers), `env://` and `vault://` secret locators, operation gates, and circuit breakers
- [Deployments and revisions](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/concepts/deployments.html): content-addressed definitions, immutable deployment revisions, `compile`, `plan`, compare-and-swap `apply`, rollback, and cluster convergence
- [Editions and capabilities](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/concepts/editions.html): Community (`orion-server`) vs. Standard and Enterprise (`orion-ext`), capability matrix, package trust tiers, and refusal error codes
- [Glossary](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/concepts/glossary.html): concise definitions of Orion's core runtime, authoring, and operational terms

## Build services

- [Author workflows](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/guides/workflows.html): parsing requests, transforming data with `map`, branching with `condition` and task groups (`children`, `mode`, `terminal`), calling connectors, and handling errors
- [Configure channels and guards](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/guides/channels.html): configuring REST routes, authentication (`api_key`, `hmac`, `jwt`), `oauth2_login`, rate limits, deduplication, response caching, backpressure, and response shaping
- [Connect databases, APIs, and caches](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/guides/connectors.html): defining `http`, `db`, and `cache` connections, choosing between the portable data dialect (`data_query`/`data_write`) and raw SQL (`db_read`/`db_write`), and managing secrets
- [Schedule jobs with cron](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/guides/scheduled-jobs.html): six-field cron schedules, IANA time zones and DST rules, misfire policies, overlap policies (`allow`, `forbid`, `replace`), and inspecting the occurrence ledger
- [Test and lint offline](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/guides/testing.html): validating definitions with `lint`, `clippy`, `fmt`, and `sql check`, running `dry-run` with connector stubs, and writing `*.case.json` regression suites
- [CI/CD and deployment workflows](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/guides/ci-cd.html): automating PR validation gates, compiling deployment artifacts, running `deployments plan` and `apply`, rolling back revisions, and using the Orion Console
- [Extend with WebAssembly plugins](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/guides/plugins.html): building custom Rust task functions compiled to `wasm32-wasip2`, writing `plugin.json`, signing with Ed25519 keys, and testing and deploying plugins
- [Build with AI assistants](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/guides/ai-authoring.html): setting up the Orion agent skill for Claude Code and Cursor, using the universal LLM prompt pack, and four worked prompt-to-deployment examples

## Standard & Enterprise

- [Overview and setup](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/enterprise/overview.html): installing and configuring `orion-ext`, setting `[extensions.licence]` and `[extensions.redis]`, and verifying active enterprise drivers and providers
- [Kafka channels and producer](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/enterprise/kafka.html): consuming Kafka topics with `protocol: "kafka"` channels (consumer groups, offset settlement, DLQ) and publishing messages with `com.orion.kafka`
- [GraphQL APIs](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/enterprise/graphql.html): serving GraphQL queries and mutations with `protocol: "graphql"` channels, routing root fields to workflows, and bounding query depth and complexity
- [Server-Sent Events (SSE)](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/enterprise/sse.html): streaming real-time events over `protocol: "sse"` channels using workflow ticks or `provider_stream`, `Last-Event-ID` resumption, and keepalives
- [Enterprise connector providers](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/enterprise/providers.html): configuring and calling the seven built-in `orion-ext` providers (`com.orion.smtp`, `com.orion.kafka`, `com.orion.redis`, `com.orion.storage`, `com.orion.mongodb`, `com.orion.elasticsearch`, `com.orion.models`)
- [Canary rollouts and traffic splitting](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/enterprise/traffic-splitting.html): splitting channel traffic across workflow revisions by percentage weight, sticky caller hashing (`sticky_header`), promotion, and instant rollback
- [Multi-node clustering and HA](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/enterprise/clustering.html): running multiple stateless `orion-ext` replicas backed by PostgreSQL/MySQL and Redis (`SharedStateStore`), cluster-wide rate limits and caches, and rolling upgrades
- [Custom provider packages](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/enterprise/provider-packages.html): scaffolding, linting, packing, uploading, and admitting custom connector provider packages (`orion-cli provider`)

## Operate

- [Production checklist](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/operate/production-checklist.html): pre-launch checklist covering `ORION_ENVIRONMENT=production`, admin auth, data-plane auth, TLS, CORS, trusted proxies, secrets, database pools, alerts, and backups
- [Deploy with Docker and Kubernetes](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/operate/deploy.html): running Orion in Docker, multi-replica HA Docker Compose with PostgreSQL and Redis, and Kubernetes deployments with the official Helm chart
- [Security and access control](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/operate/security.html): hardening admin API keys (`sha256:` digests and rotation), channel authentication, TLS termination, trusted proxy CIDRs, secret locators, SSRF guards, and CORS
- [Monitoring, metrics, and alerts](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/operate/monitoring.html): structured JSON logging, Prometheus metrics listener (`metrics.bind_addr`), OpenTelemetry OTLP tracing, `/healthz`/`/readyz`/`/health` probes, and alert rules
- [Execution traces, DLQ, and audit logs](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/operate/traces-and-audit.html): trace persistence modes (`sync`, `async`, `batch`, `off`), async trace worker queue, dead-letter queue (DLQ) replay, and admin audit log queries
- [Timeouts, retries, and circuit breakers](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/operate/resilience.html): layered timeout hierarchy, idempotent HTTP retry rules, per-connector circuit breakers, workflow error branching (`metadata._orion_errors`), and graceful shutdown
- [Backups, upgrades, and troubleshooting](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/operate/maintenance.html): SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL backup and restore procedures, rolling 2.x upgrades, blue/green migration from 1.x, and symptom-indexed troubleshooting

## Reference

- [Workflow schema and formatting](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/reference/workflows.html): complete `workflow.json` schema, tasks, recursive task groups, failure handling, shared definitions (`fragments`, `constants`, `errors`), and canonical `orion-cli fmt` rules
- [Channel configuration schema](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/reference/channels.html): complete `channel.json` schema across all protocols (`rest`, `http`, `cron`, `kafka`, `graphql`, `sse`), guard evaluation order by ingress, and all guard and response blocks
- [Connector schemas and portable data dialect](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/reference/connectors.html): connection envelope (`connections.json`), secret locators and masking, `http`/`db`/`cache` connector schemas, and the portable data dialect (`data_query` and `data_write`)
- [Task functions](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/reference/functions.html): summary catalog, canonical input field tables, and retry-safety classifications for all 23 built-in task functions plus `provider_call` and `provider_stream`
- [Expression language (JSONLogic)](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/reference/expressions.html): strict condition vs. template evaluation, `$` literal-key escaping, `engine.ops_budget`, and the complete 76-operator reference table
- [Static analysis rules (clippy)](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/reference/clippy.html): rule severities (`deny`, `warn`, `allow`), `.orion-clippy.toml` configuration, and all 20 static analysis rules across `correctness.*`, `perf.*`, `duplication.*`, and `style.*`
- [CLI reference](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/reference/cli.html): command, flag, and exit-code reference for `orion-server` and `orion-cli`
- [Admin and Data REST API](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/reference/api.html): `/api/v2/admin/*` and `/api/v2/data/*` endpoint reference, authentication headers, cursor pagination envelopes, and embedded OpenAPI 3.1 viewer
- [Server configuration and environment variables](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/reference/configuration.html): configuration precedence, `ORION_SECTION__KEY` environment overrides, startup validation rules, and all 91 server configuration settings
- [Error codes and metrics](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/reference/errors-and-metrics.html): data-plane and Admin API error code registries, all 117 structured `fields[].code` values, and all Prometheus metrics (`orion_*`)

## Releases

- [Versioning and support policy](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/releases/versioning-policy.html): supported versions, Semantic Versioning contract, edition alignment, Rust MSRV policy, supported databases, and platforms
- [Upgrade to Orion 2.0](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/releases/upgrade-to-2.0.html): breaking changes between Orion 1.x and 2.0, `/api/v2/` routes, immutable deployments, cursor pagination, tightened defaults, and edition changes
- [Orion 1.x release history](https://docs.goplasmatic.io/releases/history-1.x.html): consolidated behavioral changes, renames, and migration notes across Orion 1.8.0, 1.6.0, 1.2.0, 1.1.0, and 1.0.0
